slides.headline: GPT-5 just got 60% cheaper
slides.subtext: Your customer service bot budget just dropped overnight

slides.headline: What changed
slides.body: OpenAI cut GPT-5 API prices by 60% today. Input tokens dropped from $2.50 to $1 per million. Output fell from $10 to $4.

slides.headline: What it is
slides.body: Same GPT-5 model, same 1M-token context window, same speed. Just a lower bill starting today.

slides.headline: Who it helps
slides.body: If you run an AI chatbot, writing assistant, or support tool, your per-customer cost just became trivial.

slides.headline: What to try this week
slides.body: Revisit any AI feature you shelved for cost reasons. Rerun the math. Most ROI calcs now work.

slides.headline: AI automation just became default-affordable
slides.body: The pricing that blocked small business AI adoption in 2024 is gone. If you're not using AI in ops yet, the excuse is gone too.
